title: [IMP-25] Launch pilot work from the correct new-model build event
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-25

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-25

Title
Launch pilot work from the correct new-model build event

Category
Pilot connection

Objective
Create linked pilot work only where a new-model PPAP explicitly needs it.

Detailed scope
Add Pilot Program Link fields/controls and Launch Pilot Program using the supplied external operation. Require NEW_MODEL and a Build Event from the same governing Model Change; retain one result per explicit launch correlation.

Deliverable
A PPAP-side new-model pilot launch action and program navigation.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
IMP-11 — Set up model schedules and physical build events
IMP-17 — Resolve SIA and supplier responsibility and eligibility

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.
• IMP-11 provides the model/date/build-event fields and PPAP schedule links.
• IMP-17 provides the exact-entity role/capability checks and eligible assignment operation.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: the three local association fields can proceed; executable pilot creation/navigation needs the supplied external operation and safe retry connection.

Recommended implementer role
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment connects defined records and actions through supplied native methods. A Consultant should configure the cross-record checks and failure messages; it does not assign the external application build.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Pilot Program Link.PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP.Pilot Programs. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Pilot Program Link.Build Event
Create a link to PPAP Build Event, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects event for same Model Change. Field/control lifecycle: Launch Pilot validates PPAP.Type.Code=NEW_MODEL; event model must equal PPAP.Model Change.

PPAP Pilot Program Link.Pilot Program
Create a link to Pilot Part Program, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: External program launch adapter creates/links once per explicit launch token; no auto-creation merely because Drawing Review completes.

PPAP.Pilot Programs
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Pilot Program Link.PPAP; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Configure Launch Pilot Program for the responsible SIA PPAP Engineer on a target PPAP with Type.Code=NEW_MODEL and the one governing Model Change. Require a Build Event from that same model; validate intended parts remain within PPAP part scope.
2. Call the supplied external pilot operation with the explicit PPAP/event/part launch correlation and save Pilot Program Link.PPAP, Build Event and returned Pilot Program exactly once. A repeated successful launch returns its existing program link; failure retains native diagnostics rather than duplicate external programs.
3. Hide/deny the action for RUNNING_CHANGE and PROCESS_CHANGE. Do not create pilot programs on source release/drawing-review completion, implement shipments/measurements here or add a blanket program-complete approval gate.

How to check the result
• A running/process-change PPAP cannot launch a pilot program.
• A Build Event from another model is rejected and repeated authorized launch produces no duplicate linked program.

Information needed for this task
IN-09: Supply the external program launch action and exact PPAP/model/event/part mappings and retry token.
IN-04: Supply the supported repeat-safe external launch/result save connection.

Supplied input context
• IN-09 — New-model pilot launch connection: The Pilot Part Data owner must supply the program launch operation, identifiers and PPAP/model/build-event/part mappings, including retry correlation. The PPAP launch link waits; the pilot application and its shipments/measurements are outside this plan.
• IN-04 — Supported complete-save, copy and recovery methods: The technical team must supply the supported native methods for saving related records/files together, preventing conflicting simultaneous changes, retaining action/audit reasons, reopening an approved element without losing history, and durably resuming failed publication/submission/cancellation/outcome delivery. Only the consuming operations wait; no processing-permission or custom audit subsystem is requested.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
